title: Thread lift
caption: A thread lift uses dissolvable sutures inserted under the skin to physically lift soft tissue — think of it as repositioning rather than adding or removing anything. The threads also trigger a mild wound-healing response, which can stimulate collagen around the treated area over the following months. Results are visible but subtler than surgical lifting, and because the threads dissolve gradually, the effect is temporary. Knowing that distinction — lift versus volumise versus tighten — helps you understand which tool a practitioner is actually reaching for. Not medical advice, just the honest basics.
